_comment: Deal pipeline. Domain states mirror the DealStage enum. `closing` is the transient overlay around the store write that makes a deal Won. One request loads the deal, fires one event and saves inside one database transaction; concurrent writers serialize on the row lock.

_delays.closeTimeout: 1000 ms - upper bound on the store write that records a won deal

_ignores.win: a lead must be qualified first; the API refuses with DEAL_NOT_QUALIFIED
_ignores.reopen: only a lost deal can be reopened; the API refuses with DEAL_NOT_LOST

_ignores.qualify: already qualified; the API refuses with DEAL_ALREADY_QUALIFIED
_ignores.reopen: only a lost deal can be reopened; the API refuses with DEAL_NOT_LOST

_ignores.qualify: a lost deal must be reopened first; the API refuses with DEAL_LOST
_ignores.win: a lost deal must be reopened first; the API refuses with DEAL_LOST
_ignores.lose: already lost; the API refuses with DEAL_LOST
